_comment: Register external CLI agents as MCP servers. Copy to .mcp.json in your project root. Only Codex ships a native MCP server mode; Gemini CLI and Qwen Code are MCP clients, so reach those through Bash delegation instead (see external-cli-agents.md).

codex._comment: Exposes the codex and codex-reply tools. Session continuity via threadId lets Claude Code ask follow-ups without resending context. Marked experimental by OpenAI — command name may change between releases.
